pr_body:
Fixes two problems with the `testCopyFromOtherField` test -- it should not choose a sub-object of the copy_from field as the target field and it should "deep-compare" any copied objects contained within maps as they will _not_ be reference-equal after the fix in #69349.

Fixes #69876.

review_comment: I would be happy if there were some Hamcrest magic that did this "deep-compare" of objects within maps automatically, but I couldn't find anything along those lines.
